_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for all physical parameters in Chapter 2 (Hardware). Every number quoted in quantum_hw.tex must derive from this file via derive_canonical.py, which emits LaTeX macros. No physical value is to be typed by hand in the manuscript.

decisions.1_anharmonicity_300GHz: alpha = -15 GHz (E_J/E_C = 50). Junction-sizing branch retained; gate tables rewritten accordingly.
decisions.2_zeta_convention: zeta_zz reported as the level shift xi_ZZ = E_11 + E_00 - E_01 - E_10 (standard CR/ZZ rate). sigma_z(x)sigma_z coefficient = xi_ZZ/4 stated once for completeness. Numerical values from exact diagonalization, not the perturbative formula.

innovation_300GHz.g_provenance: Representative microwave-analog value; absolute g at 300 GHz requires EM simulation of the 3D geometry (reviewer G15). Quote with explicit hedge.

thermal_300GHz_4K._note: Thermal occupation at the 300 GHz / 4 K operating point. n_th = 1/(exp(hf/kT)-1); epsilon_thermal = n_th * 0.5 (chapter model). F_ceiling = 1 - epsilon_thermal is the fidelity ceiling imposed by the IRREDUCIBLE thermal term at fixed 300 GHz / 4 K. Lowering T is excluded by design: 4 K is the cryocooler-compatible floor; going below requires He-3/dilution, which the architecture exists to avoid.

decoherence_breakdown_innovation_us._note: Per-channel T1 contributions (microseconds) at the 300 GHz / 4 K operating point. T1_total is their harmonic sum. Verified by Wave-M re-audit (T1^qp = 49 us literature consensus, NbN Delta = 2.6 meV).

gate_fidelity._note: Ratified inputs: F_CNOT (decision 4), F_CNOT_baseline (decision 6, supersedes 99.55), epsilon_decoh (Wave-M). t_CNOT is DERIVED as epsilon_decoh * T2_echo = 152.5 ns. decoherence_ceiling = 1 - epsilon_decoh: best achievable F at this T2 if control were perfect (frames 97.9% as control-limited). F_CNOT supersedes legacy 95.95/97.3/~96.

superconductor._note: Single canonical gap. 2*Delta = 5.2 meV; Delta = 2.6 meV. Eliminate the 2.8 meV and 1.49 meV occurrences (the latter was a stray paste of Delta_gap into the leakage equation).
